description: Copy-with-override coverage across the three configuration tiers with empty and partial overrides: a base config copied with an empty override (all fields inherited, GET/true defaults applied, durations rendered as <n>s, absent header/extra/query read as null), an options tier with only a method override, a request tier overriding only data/path, and inheritance of headers/extra maps when not replaced. Demonstrates default-value resolution (method=GET, followRedirects/persistentConnection default true), duration rendering, and case-insensitive header read-then-write on the request tier.
